prompt_text: What is the best AI video ad maker?
engine_stated_criteria: Need an AI person presenting your service/software
answer_verbatim:
For most businesses making **performance-style video ads quickly**, **Creatify** is one of the best overall choices. It can turn a product URL into multiple ad concepts, generate UGC-style creators/avatars, write hooks and scripts, and produce variations for TikTok, Meta, and YouTube Shorts.

Best choice depends on what you need:

| Need | Best option | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Fast ecommerce / paid social ads | **Creatify** | Product-URL-to-ad workflow, UGC avatars, many variations |
| Realistic AI spokesperson ads | **HeyGen** | Strong avatars, voice/lip sync, multilingual support |
| Polished corporate/product explainers | **Synthesia** | Professional presenter videos, collaboration, training-style quality |
| UGC-style ads with virtual actors | **Arcads** | Built around short-form, creator-style ad production |
| Editing existing footage into ads | **CapCut** | Excellent captions, templates, pacing, mobile-first social editing |
| Design-heavy ads and brand assets | **Canva** | Easiest all-in-one design workflow for teams |
| Highest creative control | **Runway** | Generative video tools and effects, but more learning required |
| Adobe-based marketing teams | **Adobe Express / Firefly** | Convenient if your brand assets and workflow are already in Adobe |

### My practical recommendation

- **Selling physical products online:** Start with **Creatify** or **Arcads**.  
- **Need an AI person presenting your service/software:** Choose **HeyGen**.  
- **Want to make ads yourself from real clips:** Use **CapCut** plus Canva.  
- **Need premium, cinematic AI visuals rather than straightforward ads:** Use **Runway**, then edit in CapCut or Premiere.

The “best” setup is often not one tool: generate several scripts and hooks in Creatify/HeyGen, make 10–20 creative variations, then use CapCut to refine pacing, captions, music, and platform-specific cuts. For ad performance, the hook, offer, proof, and iteration rate usually matter more than whether the AI video looks perfectly cinematic.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
